description: A PHP script that interacts with device NAT configuration via functions like DmGetStrsWithRootObj, DmSetStrsWithRootObj, DmGetInstanceIds, DmAddObj, and DmDelObj; includes HTML structure and embedded PHP code for device parameter management.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple string parameters from device configuration based on root object.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple string parameters in device configuration under a specified root object.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a given device object.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under a specified device table.
